form.title: Table 1. Worksheet To Figure Your Qualified Loan Limit and Deductible Home Mortgage Interest for the Current Year

lines.caption: Enter the average balance of all your grandfathered debt. See the line 1 instructions
Enter the average balance of all your home acquisition debt incurred after October 13, 1987, and prior to December 16, 2017. See the line 2 instructions
Enter the larger of the amount on line 1 or the amount on line 3
Add the amounts on lines 1 and 2. Enter the total here
Enter the smaller of the amount on line 4 or the amount on line 5
Enter the average balance of all your home acquisition debt incurred after December 15, 2017. See the line 7 instructions
Enter the larger of the amount on line 6 or the amount on line 8
Add the amounts on lines 6 and 7. Enter the total here
Enter the smaller of line 9 or line 10. This is your qualified loan limit
Enter the total of the average balances of all mortgages from lines 1, 2, and 7 on all qualified homes. See the line 12 instructions
Enter the total amount of interest that you paid on the loans from line 12. See the line 13 instructions
Divide the amount on line 11 by the amount on line 12. Enter the result as a decimal amount (rounded to three places)
Multiply the amount on line 13 by the decimal amount on line 14. Enter the result. This is your deductible home mortgage interest. Enter this amount on Schedule A (Form 1040)
Subtract the amount on line 15 from the amount on line 13. Enter the result. This isn't home mortgage interest. See the line 16 instructions
